definitions.explanation: An injury to the skin caused by heat, fire, hot liquids, or steam.

examples.japanese: {熱|あつ}いお{湯|ゆ}で{火傷|やけど}した。
examples.english: I got burned by hot water.

examples.japanese: {火傷|やけど}には{冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}をかけてください。
examples.english: Please run cold water over the burn.

examples.japanese: {軽|かる}い{火傷|やけど}なら{薬|くすり}を{塗|ぬ}れば{大丈夫|だいじょうぶ}です。
examples.english: If it's a minor burn, applying medicine should be fine.

notes:
USAGE: {火傷|やけど} can be used as a noun or with する as a suru-verb ({火傷|やけど}する = to get burned).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{火傷|やけど}をする (to get a burn)
・{火傷|やけど}を{負|お}う (to sustain a burn - formal)
・{火傷|やけど}が{治|なお}る (the burn heals)
・{火傷|やけど}の{跡|あと} (burn scar)

SEVERITY LEVELS:
・{軽度|けいど}の{火傷|やけど} (minor burn)
・{重度|じゅうど}の{火傷|やけど} (severe burn)

WARNING: For serious burns, seek medical attention. The expression {火傷|やけど}の{功名|こうみょう} (lit. success from getting burned) means achieving something through a mistake or failure.
